text:
The evidence confirms **67.7 ha of tree-cover loss in 2020**, but it does not establish whether that loss was deforestation. Tree-cover loss alone does not determine the cause or subsequent land use.

The loss occurred before the 31 December 2020 baseline. For 2021–2025, no loss event of at least 0.5 ha was detected, although 0.4 ha of loss in smaller patches was recorded in 2021. The JRC 2020 reference map classified none of the property as forest.

These findings do not establish a regulatory or compliance outcome.
